purpose: Qualify a generated classic 3D POLYLINE through AC1021 DWG writing, installed dwg2dxf conversion and FreeCAD native C++ DXF import.

source.provenance: Generated from scratch in /tmp; no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

convertedDxf.recordCheck: Generated output contains the POLYLINE header, four VERTEX records and SEQEND. Native FreeCAD import verifies the exact WCS vertices.

consumer.route: FreeCAD Draft DWG open/insert -> hash-checked installed dwg2dxf -> C++ DXF importer

validation.fixturePolicy: The committed source generates the DWG at runtime. Test DWG/DXF outputs stay in isolated temporary directories; no fixture was added.

limitations: This is one generated AC1021 3D POLYLINE profile, in the FreeCAD 1.1.4 macOS ARM64 route only.
Hosted FreeCAD 1.1.3 Linux/Windows execution, other POLYLINE flags and vertex profiles, physical producer breadth, native DWG support and broad application semantics remain open.
supportClaimEffect: Adds bounded native-consumer geometry evidence for this generated AC1021 classic 3D POLYLINE profile only; no broad format-support claim is promoted.
